verdict.rationale: Devin's MCP integration supports cron-based and one-time scheduling with notification preferences (devin-docs-17), and its API allows external systems to trigger sessions programmatically (devin-docs-8, devin-docs-9), giving some automation-on-event capability. However, there's no documented general event-trigger/rule engine (e.g., 'on PR opened, on ticket created, on webhook received') beyond scheduling and manual tagging in Slack/Teams (devin-docs-4). Missing for 10: a documented rules/trigger system tied to arbitrary external events, independent confirmation of automation reliability, and broader event types beyond cron schedules.
